items.text: drag a ring from anywhere on its middle, the name and the pin included, not only the grip; the panel arrow, the ring switch and a slider keep their own touch, and a tap is still a tap
the Touch ring is push, steer or magnet. The hand in the middle turns touch on and off (lit when on): off, the dots dim and keep your choice, and nothing that says off is ever lit

touchable sound is a second page on your choice: tap the lit dot again and two points on its edge show the page, and its edge pulses with the sound. With touch off it still plays: the picture stays still, your finger plays
touchable sound has its own mark, a fingertip on a wave, on the Touch ring and on the Sound ring (finger), one switch in both places
Touch panel › ring labels: learn (they fade once you know them), always or never
the rings are tighter: a smaller middle, the dots closer to it
the ring keeps in step with the bar: turn the robot on or mute from the bar, a key or a shelf and an open (or pinned) ring shows it at once, and still turns to move
a path's numbered dot under a bar button also sits on the ring dot that does the same thing
the ring's middle is a round button, like the bar button it came from: the hand for Touch, a play arrow for Play, the speaker for Sound, with the pin, grip, panel and switch round its edge
the Play ring holds still/move and mute too, beside the robot and the dice
the ring's middle reads like a bar button: the pin on the left, the grip's dots on the right, the panel's caret a bump on top, and the ring switch a bump underneath, its list opening below
preset pills sit on one row and scroll sideways (the mixer, the mic, Pulse, the field), the far edge fading while more wait
a ring's panel is a caret notched into the top of its name, and the grip a tab on its bottom edge; the Sound ring gets one too, opening the Sound panel
the pin stands up solid when pinned and leans as an outline when loose
the words under a ring's dots stay longer for your first few rings, then fade once you know them; press or hover brings one back

in Safari a ring's slider (volume, flow) kept adding a tick each time you tapped its dot, its track shrank to the knob, and near the edge it ran off the screen: now one slider, full length, kept on screen
Safari no longer enlarges some words beside others (the cover's line "Free beta · v… · Pro testing", the slider's name)
